name: Standard Foods Corporation
summary: Established in 1979 and headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan, Standard Foods Corporation – previously known as Standard Foods Taiwan Ltd. until its 2002 rebranding – operates as a multi-faceted enterprise. The company is a prominent producer and distributor of various nutritional provisions, including edible oils, dairy goods, and beverages, serving markets both within Taiwan and globally. Its extensive food product range encompasses a variety of cereals such as baby, oatmeal, fruit, and ready-to-eat options, alongside sesame paste, powdered milk, and other grain-based offerings. Beyond foodstuffs, Standard Foods also ventures into the manufacturing and sales of computer hardware and household appliances, as well as cosmetic products. Furthermore, its operations extend to real estate management, international trade (import and export activities), and providing expertise in health technology through investment, consulting, and technical transfers.
